title: Quad by MEDVi vs Rex MD: Two Very Different Online ED Options
description:
Quad by MEDVi and Rex MD compared: a single compounded dissolvable dose versus a wide menu of branded and generic options.

What we compared:
• Quad by MEDVi: compounded 4-in-1 ("quad-blend") formula in a single dose; fast-dissolving, no pill to swallow; Rx-only after a licensed-provider review; prescribed and managed through MEDVi telehealth
• Rex MD: branded and generic Viagra and Cialis, plus daily tadalafil; Ignite ED gummy (sildenafil + tadalafil compound); US-licensed provider review; free 2-day discreet delivery

Provider details as listed in our reviews (updated Oct 9, 2026). Confirm current options on each provider's site.

Full guide: https://www.treatmentshub.com/ed
The comparison page this video is based on was reviewed for medical accuracy by Francheska Capistrano, RMT, MPH (medical content reviewer) on Oct 30, 2026.

Important:
• The presenter in this video is AI-generated.
• TreatmentsHub is a comparison site, not a medical provider. This is general information, not medical advice.
• Prescription treatment needs an evaluation by a licensed clinician, who decides whether it's right for you.
• Compounded products are not FDA-approved the way brand or generic pills are; whether one is appropriate is a provider's decision.
• Never combine an ED medication (PDE5 inhibitor) with nitrates. Tell the clinician about every medication you take.
• We may earn a commission from partner links. It never affects our rankings.
